prompt:
Create a faithful illustrated 2D fighting game full-body sprite atlas of THE FEAR from ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid 3 Snake Eater (2004), original PS2 model, NOT Delta or HD reinterpretation. Exact original identity and outfit from reference original-promo-0044 and PS2 intro: tall wiry muscular pale adult man, severe angular clean-shaven face, short black slicked-back hair with conspicuous WHITE streaks at BOTH temples, pronounced widow peak, no long ponytail. LONG-SLEEVED military fatigues matching the source: brown-olive khaki base covered by dark charcoal-black irregular tiger camouflage stripes, pointed open collar, same camo trousers. FULL dark black-blue gloves and dark lace-up combat boots. Never bare chest or bare arms, no torn shirt, no gold armor. BLACK shoulder webbing/chest harness with tall central vertical ribbed rectangular BLACK chest quiver/pouch block and small silver buckles, not an armored plate carrier. Olive khaki rectangular pouch at ANATOMICAL RIGHT front hip, smaller rear/belt fittings, dark belt, long narrow slack black webbing strap ends near legs. Anatomical RIGHT hip pouch must remain RIGHT on both independently drawn views. Outfit from original reference, not Naked Snake's rolled sleeves, not The Sorrow sweater, not remake.

The reference compact crossbow is LITTLE JOE: matte black small pistol-grip crossbow held in anatomical RIGHT hand, thin exposed straight central bolt rail, SHORT squared paired bow limbs connected in a triangular/trapezoid braced frame, thin taut black string across ends. No rifle barrel, magazine, optic, laser, gun stock, arrow quiver on back, fantasy large bow or firearm. Preserve exact depicted original mechanical silhouette; compact rail length about one forearm. No loaded loose flying arrow, no muzzle flash, no supernatural aura. Crossbow stays attached to gripping hand.

Make exactly TWELVE isolated complete figures of the SAME character, 4 columns x 3 rows equal INVISIBLE cells, row-major. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha PNG, WIDE landscape atlas. Generous transparent gutters at least 25 native pixels around each full figure, weapons, fingers, boot, strap and hair and at outer edges; 12 clearly separate alpha components. No text, labels, numbers, visible grid, background, ground shadow, trees, other people or detached props. Consistent upright source body scale in all cells; crouch and air tuck must remain physically smaller, never enlarge low postures. Detailed painted style, controlled dark contour, restrained realistic original palette, orthographic side view with modest three-quarter torso to see original gear. ALL 12 directly FACE SCREEN RIGHT; head/nose, feet and movement RIGHT. Each view is drawn independently; do not mirror source or swap anatomical hands or equipment sides.

POSE ORDER row-major exactly: 0 quick LEFT jab startup, left fist coiled near chin, RIGHT hand keeps small Little Joe bow LOW by waist; 1 quick LEFT jab active, LEFT fist punches directly FORWARD screen RIGHT at chest level, RIGHT bow-hand close hip; 2 jab recovery draw left fist toward sternum, right bow remains low. 3 heavy forceful shove/grapple startup, step forward, LEFT fingers open and elbow coiled, RIGHT bow-hand close chest; 4 ACTIVE forceful LEFT open-palm thrust / reaching capture, LEFT arm fully reaches forward screen RIGHT, RIGHT arm moves close chest holding small bow, shoulders engaged; 5 shove/capture recoil, LEFT hand pulls toward chest and RIGHT bow-hand drops low, no caught opponent. These 3..5 intentionally serve both heavy push and authored versus grapple. 6 low sweep startup deep low crouch, body bends down, RIGHT bow held beside torso; 7 active low boot sweep FRONT boot extended straight toward screen RIGHT near ground, head/nose still faces RIGHT, RIGHT bow remains tucked close chest; 8 sweep recovery compact crouch knees bent drawing boot back, bow close torso. 9 hurt reaction one backward body recoil, face still toward RIGHT, no blood or particles. 10 knockout folding onto knees, bow retained in right hand, full limbs visible; 11 knockout flat on side, entire horizontal body head-to-boots fits comfortably in final invisible cell, FACE/head/nose points RIGHT, compact bent legs to avoid very wide cropping, RIGHT small bow remains ATTACHED to gloved right hand near sternum, no detached weapon. Every pose isolated, no detached trail copies or other person. Use strong clear animation keyframes, all weapons/straps entirely inside own cell, generous true-alpha gaps. All 12 face SCREEN RIGHT; this is an INDEPENDENT original opposite view, never mirrored. Native gear stays on anatomical side.
